title: lastrea uraiensis
intro: Lastrea uraiensis, commonly known as the Japanese lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat various infections and reduce inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Lastrea uraiensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential applications in traditional medicine.
